title: Protected Cultivation Systems Explained: From Open Field to NFT Hydroponics
excerpt: This article introduces the foundational layers of protected cultivation, starting from open-field farming and progressing through shade net houses to NFT hydroponic systems. It explains how each system incrementally modifies the crop environment, focusing on light management, microclimate moderation, and root-zone precision. Special emphasis is placed on why leafy vegetables and short-cycle crops respond well to shade-based structures and NFT hydroponics. The guide helps growers understand when basic protection is sufficient and when precision nutrient control becomes commercially valuable.
